dataList.title:
前往四楼
 Head to 4F
dataList.description:
我们现在拿到了验真证书，是三楼的漆黑者送给我们的。他们说，其他漆黑者也会给我们同样的礼遇——听起来是相当奢华的那种。希望这能让我们在这座百货商店里活动得更轻松一些。

现在，往楼上走，去四楼吧。
 We now have the Authenticity Certificate, courtesy of the Noirs on 3F. They told us that other Noirs will show us the same hospitality they showed us—the lavish kind, apparently. Hopefully, it'll make getting around the department store a little easier.

Now, let's head upstairs to 4F.

steps.goalDescription1:
搭乘电梯前往四楼
 Get on the escalator to 4F

dataList.title:
探索四楼
 Explore 4F
dataList.description:
我们到了四楼。不知道这里会有什么样古怪的商店呢？先去看看右边走廊那边有什么吧。
 We're on 4F. What kind of weird stores will we find here, I wonder? Let's start by checking out what's to the hallway on the right.

dataList.title:
探索四楼（2）
 Explore 4F (2)
dataList.description:
漆黑者鞋履厅的店员一腿，跟我们说起了一件能撕裂任何布料的传说武器。
现在，先离开漆黑者鞋履厅，去探索四楼其余的地方吧。
 A One-leg, sales associate at the Noir Footwear Hall, told us about a legendary weapon capable of ripping through any fabric.
For now, let's leave the Noir Footwear Hall and explore the rest of 4F.

steps.goalDescription1:
与一腿谈完话
 Finish talking to One-leg

steps.goalDescription2:
与弧光落地目灯交谈
 Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp

dataList.title:
拜见家具厅店主
 Meet the Owner of the Furniture Hall
dataList.description:
所以，这里就是“家具厅”了，是吧？
我们跟弧光落地目灯谈过后，他请我们给他带一套“最时髦、最合适”的行头。去见见家具厅的店主吧。
 So, this is the "Furnishing Hall," huh?
The Arc Floor Lamp we talked to asked that we bring him an outfit "most fashionable and suitable." Let's go meet the owner of the Furniture Hall.

steps.goalDescription1:
与家具厅店主交谈
 Talk to the owner of the Furniture Hall

dataList.title:
把新衣服送给弧光落地目灯
 Deliver the New Clothes to the Arc Floor Lamp
dataList.description:
家具厅的店主“快乐衣橱”打开了自己，向我们展示了一些从其躯干内垂挂而出的物件。我们挑了一件看起来还算合适的衣服——现在，把它送给弧光落地目灯吧。
 The owner of the Furniture Hall, "Happy Closet," opened themselves up to show us some items dangling from inside their body. We picked an outfit that seemed adequate—now, let's bring this to the Arc Floor Lamp.

steps.goalDescription1:
把新衣服送给弧光落地目灯
 Bring the new article of clothing for the Arc Floor Lamp

dataList.title:
从快乐衣橱那里拿更多衣服
 Take More Clothes from the Happy Closet
dataList.description:
看到弧光落地目灯拿到了一件衣服，其他家具们可不怎么高兴。回到快乐衣橱那儿，替剩下的家具们也挑几件衣服吧。
 The other Furnishings weren't so happy to see the Arc Floor Lamp receive an article of clothing. Let's return to the Happy Closet and pick out clothes for the rest of the Furnishings.

steps.goalDescription1:
从快乐衣橱那里拿更多衣服
 Take more articles of clothing from the Happy Closet

dataList.title:
把衣服送给家具们
 Deliver the Clothes to the Furnishings
dataList.description:
从快乐衣橱那里挑了几件衣服。现在，把它们送给家具们吧。
 Picked out a few articles of clothing from the Happy Closet. Now, to deliver them to the Furnishings.

steps.goalDescription1:
送给骨骸衣架
 Delivery for Bonehanger
steps.goalDescription2:
送给松软皮床
 Delivery for Mellow Leather Bed
steps.goalDescription3:
送给剥制皮帘
 Delivery for Taxidermied Leather Curtain
steps.goalDescription4:
送给红垫凳
 Delivery for Red-cushioned Stool
steps.goalDescription5:
送给生皮沙发
 Delivery for Skinhide Couch
steps.goalDescription6:
送给双子灯
 Delivery for Lamp Twin

dataList.title:
回到快乐衣橱身边
 Return to the Happy Closet
dataList.description:
确认每一件愤怒的家具都收到了自己的衣服。该回快乐衣橱那儿去了。
 Made sure that each of the angry Furnishings received their article of clothing. Time to head back to the Happy Closet.

steps.goalDescription1:
回到快乐衣橱身边
 Return to the Happy Closet

家具们正在把快乐衣橱撕碎。
 The Furnishings are ripping the Happy Closet apart.

dataList.title:
与弧光落地目灯交谈
 Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp
dataList.description:
快乐衣橱，连心脏都被摘走了，已经彻底静止不动。离开家具厅之前，或许该找弧光落地目灯谈谈。
 The Happy Closet, with even their heart torn out, has gone completely still. Maybe we should talk to the Arc Floor Lamp before we get out of the Furniture Hall.

steps.goalDescription1:
与弧光落地目灯交谈
 Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp

dataList.title:
前往地下楼层
 Head to the Basement Floors
dataList.description:
根据我们拿到的配方，首先得弄到这枚“金色蚕茧”，才能进而取得金丝线。

去地下一层，拿到金色蚕茧，然后再深入地下二层吧。
 According to the recipe we acquired, we're first going to have to obtain this "Golden Cocoon," which will lead to us getting our hands on the Golden Thread.

Let's head to B1F, acquire the Golden Cocoon, then head deeper down to B2F.

 Get on the escalator to B1F

 Explore B1F
